title: conditional_column: create a column from a condition
description: Create a new column by testing a condition on another column and writing true/false branch values. Use this for flags, labels, and simple if-then logic.

parameters.name: true_value
parameters.description: Value written when condition is true.

parameters.name: false_value
parameters.description: Value written when condition is false.

rag_note: If the user gives an ambiguous condition or labels, ask for clarification before planning this step.
